item.title: Issue with pedestrian crossing sensor/sequence, 1st August
item.description:
Problem with the pedestrian crossing button/sensor when crossing over Southam Lane from the Evesham Road side to the Cheltenham Road side (corner of the rugby club). When pressing the button to cross, the button lights up red but most times the light will go off again after a few seconds, with the green man stage being missed from the sequence. Sometimes to cross here you have to press the button multiple times and wait through two or three complete sequences before the green man stage works.

item.title: A large area on the pavement has disintegrated., 1st August
item.description:
The pavement immediately outside 4 Greenhills Close was supposedly repaired sometime earlier. When I spoke to the "surveyor" who marked a small area, he informed me that he was not allowed to mark a larger area which obviously would need future work. When the repairers arrived, I pointed out to them that the whole area approx. 2 sq metres needed to be filled, they agreed, but could only repair the area designated. The repair lasted a matter of a few weeks before it started to disintegrate again. I have to say that it was a very shoddy piece of work and the whole area needs to be completely recovered not just a small ptch.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Greenhills Close, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham
